title: 河岸校准图独立三主体 / Riverside focal props

reference.role: Actual image input in EACH generate_image request; isolated sprites were newly generated, never cut from this landscape.

normal_convention.axes: +X image right / +Y image up / +Z toward viewer
normal_convention.method: Manually authored geometric surface regions, not albedo-gradient emboss. Normal alpha exactly matches sprite alpha.

runtime: Only RGBA, normal, lamp linear grayscale emission and manifest in assets/gloam/riverside/props/. Previews and original files remain in tools/.
scope: Static single-direction sprites only. No animation or unseen back-side geometry is claimed. Runtime relighting and water reflections are not verified here; the main agent owns game integration and runtime verification.
processing: Each isolated object was newly generated using the approved full reference as actual image input; no scenery pixels are used in the runtime sprites.

Chroma/alpha key, largest connected component, cropped premultiplied BOX reduction to the target native footprint, limited palette with no dithering, and binary coverage. Raw lamp is genuinely WEBP; traveler and stone are PNG.

Hand-authored structural normal planes are preserved in surface-regions.json; normal regions follow roof slopes, glass faces, post, hood curvature, cloak folds, stone cap/front/right bevel and two sparse fissures.

Only geometric glass regions intersected with actual yellow glass material emit. Emission is uncoloured linear grayscale; ordinary objects have no emission. Light centre is in native top-left image coordinates.

Opened actual final nearest-neighbour albedo/normal sheet, opposite-white-light diagnostic and glass-only emission sheet. Silhouettes are clean on light and green backgrounds with no floor, baked exterior shadow, glow, reflection, white rim or fake checkerboard.
Original user-riverside.png was visually compared as a direction cross-check only; it is not the generation style source.
limitations: The stone side is intrinsically a little darker in the model albedo; normal response changes visibly with opposite offline lights, but the normal does not invent unseen geometry.
Single-frame rear-three-quarter traveler looks up/right; there are no additional facings or animation frames.
The material diagnostics are offline image processing, never presented as Bevy gameplay evidence.
